IS: 8696 -1978 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
GUIDE, SAW, DE MARTEL'S PATTERN 



(Reaffirmed 1997) 



1- Scope — Covers material, dimensions and other requirements for De Martel's pattern saw guide 
in two sizes used in neurosurgery. 

2. Material — Stainless steel strip conforming to Designation 30CM3 of IS: 6911-1972 'Specification 
for stainless steel plate, sheet and strip'-'. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




ENLARGEO VIEWS 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 GUIDE, SAW, DE MARTEL'S PATTERN 

3-1 A deviation of ± 2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The guide shall be of one piece construction and shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks and other 
surface defects. It shall have a gentle inside curve, concave towards the hook side as shown in 
Fig. 1. The front end or tip shall be suitably thickened by means of silver soldering as shown in 
Fig. 1- 

4.2 The hook for wire saw shall be punched out of strip and formed in the shape as shown 
in Fig. 1. It shall be sufficiently strong and shall not be liable to yield or break up during use. 

4.3 All edges of the guide, including the hook for wire saw, shall be evenly rounded and shall be 
nowhere sharp. The silver soldering shall be clean and sound. 

4.4 The guide shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment — The guide shall be suitably hardened and tempered to give a uniform hardness 
of 400 to 450 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Flexibility Test — Bring two ends of the guide closer towards the concave side, to a distance 
of 50 mm from each other and release them. Repeat it five times. As a result of this test, the guide 
shall not acquire a permanent set.

IS = 8696-1978 

6.2 Load Test — Holding the guide vertically, hang a load of 20N (2 kgf approximately) from the 
guide hook for a period of 5 minutes. The hook shall not yield or open up during the test. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance — The guide shall show no sign of corrosion or staining, when tested in 
accordance with IS : 7531-1975 ' Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments '. 

7. Marking -Each guide shall be marked by etching or otherwise with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or recognized trade-mark, along with its size, that is, ' Adult' or ' Child ' as the case may be. 

7.1 IS! Certification Marking- Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing —The guide shall be packed in a polyethylene cover. It may also be packed as agreed 
to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Printed at New India Printing Press, Khurja, India
